messages:
Alex P: Morning — quick async standup.
What I did: rolled rl-ratepolicy v3 to staging and ran a small smoke test of token-bucket changes.
Blockers: seeing ~0.8% 429s on long-tail requests, specifically /v1/generate when clients burst after idle. Latency at 99p rose a bit.
Today: will dig into per-route `burst` vs `window_ms`, update CR #842, and coord canary. @Maya R can you sanity-check the canary graphs?

Maya R: saw the canary. 99p for jwt-auth routes up from ~120ms -> ~160ms, 429s clustered on /v1/generate (same as you said). I can help tune `burst` and monitor metrics.

Samir: pinging on CR #842 — left inline comments about default_token_count and a small nits on the unit tests. Repro steps I used:
```
hey-load --rps 120 --endpoints "/v1/generate" --header "X-Test-Client: burst-small"
```
Got the 429s locally after ~90s.

Jamal: I'll own the route config change after you update the CR, Alex. Quick question — prefer shrinking `window_ms` to limit burst duration or bump `burst` to absorb short spikes?

Tess: lean towards increasing `burst` for now. Changing `window_ms` affects many clients and can increase overall request concurrency. Also add `tokens_consumed_per_route` metric before we flip to prod.

Alex P: sounds good. I'll adjust CR to bump `burst` to 20 on /v1/generate and add the new metric. Tagging @deploy-bot to canary after merge.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for `gateway-prod` — canary instances 1/10. Monitoring hooks enabled. No errors in initial health checks.

Maya R: LGTM on the proposed bump — once Samir addresses comments we can merge and watch the canary.

Samir: fixing comments now, pushing a small follow-up in ~25m.

Jamal: note: let's also watch authz cache TTL — on heavy bursts JWT validation CPU jumps a bit. Might be worth increasing `jwks_cache_ttl` for the short term.

Tess: added a short note in routing playbook: https://internal.redwood.com/playbooks/rate_limits.md — includes rollback steps and metric dashboards to watch. :thumbsup:

Alex P: thanks all — I'll post a short follow-up once canary hits 3/10 and we see stable 99p. If anyone wants pairing on the CR ping me. End.
